summary: OPENAI 🔥: GPT-6 and Intelligent UI are rolling out to all ChatGPT users. Intelligent UI lets ChatGPT create an interactive experience to explain requested topics. It seems like we are not getting GPT-6.1 on ChatGPT yet. https://t.co/KkbighJAtW
